_agi_canonical.title: BTC Recovered-Flow Contingent Execution
_agi_canonical.bar: State-contingent parent-order execution with completion, classifier, refresh, and toxic-burst fallback constraints.
_agi_canonical.derivation: 210 / 35 = 6 children, and 6 * 45 = 270 seconds. The smallest guaranteed-fill band is 61,230 to 61,250; equal half fills yield 61,240. A 35-BTC hidden child is below the classifier threshold and a toxic burst triggers the explicit repost branch.
